decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposal contained in the application and the plans submitted and numbered therewith 001.000, 001.00, 001.70 received 20/12/2012, Design and Access Statement received 16/01/2012, 003.00 rev A, 003.70 rev B received 23/02/2012approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension and timber garden deck to the ground floor flat and replacement of two windows with uPVC sash windows
